metadata.description: Claude Code plugins we build and use at Ryde Ventures

plugins.name: personas
plugins.description: Session-aware persona advisors with project-scoped threads and memory. Bundled pack of public-figure personas; pluggable for third-party personas via git repos.

plugins.name: parley
plugins.description: Cross-session peer agents for Claude Code. Ask one project what another knows, with full context and memory across turns.

plugins.name: ralph
plugins.description: An opinionated take on the Ralph autonomous loop for Claude Code. Define user stories, run the loop, check back when it's done.
